activity_summary: You stood Trinity Sunday at St Helen's. Halberds were at the Mayor's pew, and they had not been there on Whitsunday. You did not count them. Sir John sat behind them and did not speak. Master Thwaite preached that the powers that be are ordained of God, that masters are to keep their servants in, and whoso resisteth. He turned the glass once and set it down. Verbeke came with the house, because not to come would be noticed. Mistress Ansell took you out by your own door.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Saw the halberds and did not count them, heard the ordinance, and went home with the house.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached the ordinance and set the glass down after one turning.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the pew together and took them out by their own door.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Came because not coming would be noticed, and left at her pace.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat in the Mayor's pew. He did not speak.

entities.name: St Helen's
entities.context: Mentioned in One turning, under the halberds

facets.activity: Heard the glass turned once at St Helen's

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The powers that be are ordained of God.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Mark me. He set it down on Whitsunday by order, and he has set it down today.

quotes.speaker: gillis_verbeke
quotes.text: I come with the house, mistress. Not to come would be noticed.
